    • getPaymentAddress

      public org.ngengine.lnurl.LnUrl getPaymentAddress() throws URISyntaxException
      Get either the LNURL or LN Address from the user metadata, whichever is available.
      Returns:
      the LNURL or LN Address returned as a LnUrl object, so that they can be used interchangeably.
      Throws:
      URISyntaxException

    • setPaymentAddress

      public void setPaymentAddress(@Nullable org.ngengine.lnurl.LnUrl paymentAddress)
      Sets the payment address in the user metadata. This can be either a LnUrl or a LnAddress, the method will handle both cases with the appropriate metadata fields. If the payment address is null, it will remove both "lud06" and "lud16" fields from the metadata.
      Parameters:
      paymentAddress - the payment address to set, can be either a LnUrl or a LnAddress, or null to remove it.
